name: Instructions Transactions Sequence 2
definition: Provides input capability for multiple instructions on elective corporate action events via a single instruction message through using Transaction Sequence Number.

TransactionSequenceNumber.name: Transaction Sequence Number
TransactionSequenceNumber.definition: Number which further identifies DTC instruction reference number. Not applicable to reorganisation / custody deposits.

InstructionQuantity.name: Instruction Quantity
InstructionQuantity.definition: Instruction quantity for a given transaction sequence number.

OversubscriptionQuantity.name: Oversubscription Quantity
OversubscriptionQuantity.definition: For rights subscription events with an oversubscription feature, the quantity of the oversubscription for the given instruction.

CustomerReferenceIdentification.name: Customer Reference Identification
CustomerReferenceIdentification.definition: Customer identification entered by client upon instruction submission.
